topic: University students and teachers protest soaring rents, living costs and education spending; student tent camp at Syntagma Square then national march
scale: About 10,000 in Athens (police), also Thessaloniki and Patras; thousands per AP
quote1: Engineering student Panagiotis Moschonas, 20, criticized the conservative government for not taking any measures to help students cope with the high cost of living.
quote2: Organized by student associations from universities across the Greek capital, the protest includes a rally outside the Finance Ministry at 6 p.m., followed by concerts and an overnight gathering in Syntagma Square.
